description: This file defines the on_page_load event handler for the 'organizational-chart' page in a Frappe-based ERPNext application. It initializes the page UI, loads a hierarchy chart bundle, and creates either a mobile or desktop version of an organizational chart component based on device type, displaying breadcrumbs for navigation.

classes.name: erpnext.HierarchyChartMobile
classes.description: Mobile version of the hierarchy chart display component.

classes.name: erpnext.HierarchyChart
classes.description: Desktop version of the hierarchy chart display component.

methods.name: frappe.pages['organizational-chart'].on_page_load
methods.description: Initializes the organizational chart page, loads dependencies, and sets up the hierarchical display with mobile or desktop adaptation.
